data.heading: The urinary system
data.text: The urinary system is also known as the renal system. It helps to keep the right amount of water in the body.
There are two kidneys in our body. The kidneys act as filters in our body.
The kidneys help in removing the toxins from our body, absorbing them from the blood and passing them to the ureters.
There are two ureters in our body. The ureters are tubes that transport urine from the kidneys to the bladder.
The job of the bladder is to store the urine until you go to the toilet.
The urine passes out of our body through the urethra.
